title: feed.odds_changed
description: Prices or statuses of a fixture's markets changed (C05 §7). Published by the feed service on NATS subject evt.feed.odds_changed (version 1), one event per applied provider message: every market the message changed, as stored after it. Odds are the provider's raw prices, before any tenant margin (C06 applies that when it serves a price). This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. Feed events are global: the envelope's tenant_id is null (B4a plan, decision 5). New fields are additive only.

fixture_id.description: Catalogue fixture ID (opaque; contract fixtures keep the contract's IDs, e.g. fx_arsenal_chelsea)

ts_ms.description: The provider's timestamp of the message, Unix milliseconds; changes apply in this order (FEED-07)

id.description: The outcome ID slips, bets and bookings use

odds.description: Raw provider odds; null when the provider has no price

active.description: The provider offers this outcome (its market's status still decides whether it can be bet on)
